name: portal-reference
description: Reference monorepo for the Portal micro-frontend platform (host, remotes, platform packages, mock backends, CLI).

scripts.dev: portal-cli registry build --registry registry --stand local --out .infra/stands/local/config.json && concurrently -k -n infra,tasks,legacy,host -c gray,green,yellow,cyan "pnpm infra" "pnpm --filter tasks-remote dev" "pnpm --filter legacy-remote dev" "pnpm --filter host dev"
scripts.demo:uat: pnpm --filter host build && node tools/infra/src/deploy-host.ts uat && pnpm release:tasks:uat && pnpm release:legacy:uat
scripts.deploy:host:uat: pnpm --filter host build && portal-cli registry check --registry registry --stand uat --against apps/host/dist/compat.json && node tools/infra/src/deploy-host.ts uat && portal-cli registry build --registry registry --stand uat --out .infra/stands/uat/config.json
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm verify
